title: Comment “Voice” and I’ll send the link to try ChatGPT Voice👇 OpenAI just did it again
description: Comment “Voice” and I’ll send the link to try ChatGPT Voice👇 OpenAI just did it again. They launched the new chatgpt voice mode directly inside the desktop app, and this genuinely feels like something out of a movie. You can now have real back-and-forth conversations with ChatGPT, Work, or Codex. And instead of just replying, it actually goes off and completes real tasks on its own. Here’s how it works: Open the ChatGPT desktop app, choose Work or Codex, and you’ll see voice mode right there. I said: “Can you pull up that spreadsheet we built for my brand campaigns last week and add this week’s numbers to it?” It searched my threads, found the right one, and pulled up the spreadsheet in the chat. You can even interrupt it midway through. I jumped in and said “while you’re at it, check my Slack and make sure I didn’t miss anything important today,” and it started running the triage instantly. The coolest part? You’re not tied to your desk. Open the ChatGPT app on your phone, choose the Remote tab, tap the voice icon, and you can control your paired computer with your voice even when you’re away from it. I asked what was finished before heading out, and it gave me a full status update on everything still running. This genuinely feels like talking to a real coworker. Natural, interruptible, and actually useful. Go try it inside the ChatGPT Desktop app today. #ChatGPTPartner
